newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp to sell six branches.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp to sell six branches.

text.p: KeyCorp said Monday it reached a definitive agreement for the sale of three of its branches in Lorain County, Ohio, to Lorain National Bank and three of its branches in southern Ohio to Lebanon Citizens National Bank.
Completion of both sales is expected during the third quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approvals and various other conditions, KeyCorp said.
As of December 31, 1996, the three Lorain County branches had total deposits of about $55 million and loans of about $18 million, KeyCorp said.
The branches currently employ about 20 people. Under the terms of the agreement, Lorain National Bank will offer employment to all employees, KeyCorp said.
As of December 31, 1996, the three branches in southern Ohio had total deposits of about $53 million and loans of about $11 million, KeyCorp said.
The branches currently employ 19 people. Under the terms of the agreement, Lebanon Citizens will offer employment to all employees, KeyCorp said.
